# Setup

## Load dependencies

```{r}
library(here)
library(Seurat)
library(data.table)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(msigdbr)
library(viridis)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggrepel)
library(GEOquery)
```

## set seed to improve reproducability

```{r}
set.seed(123)
```

## Create file structure

```{r}
dirs <- c(
  "scRNAseq_MS/data/raw",
  "scRNAseq_MS/data/processed",
  "scRNAseq_MS/outs"
)

lapply(
  dirs,
  \(d) dir.create(here(d),
                  recursive = TRUE,
                  showWarnings = FALSE)
)
```

# Compile data into Seurat object

## Load files from GEO (#GSE180759)

```{r}
getGEOSuppFiles(
  "GSE180759",
  baseDir = "data/raw"
)

list.files(
  "data/raw/GSE180759",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)
```

## Pull in expression/metadata information

```{r}
expr <- fread(here("scRNAseq_MS", "data", "raw", "GSE180759", "GSE180759_expression_matrix.csv.gz"))
meta <- fread(here("scRNAseq_MS", "data", "raw", "GSE180759", "GSE180759_annotation.txt.gz"))

dim(expr)
dim(meta)
colnames(meta)
head(meta)
```

## Prepare expression matrix

```{r}
mem.maxVSize(32768)

expr <- as.data.frame(expr)

gene_names <- expr$V1
expr$V1 <- NULL
expr <- as.matrix(expr)
rownames(expr) <- gene_names
head(rownames(expr))

expr <- as.matrix(expr)
expr <- Matrix(expr, sparse = TRUE)

dim(expr)
expr[1:5, 1:5]
```

## Prepare metadata

```{r}
meta <- as.data.frame(meta)

rownames(meta) <- meta$nucleus_barcode

head(meta)
colnames(meta)
```

## Match expression matrix and metadata

```{r}
common_cells <- intersect(colnames(expr), rownames(meta))

expr <- expr[, common_cells]
meta <- meta[common_cells, ]

all(colnames(expr) == rownames(meta))
length(common_cells)
```

## Create Seurat object

```{r}
obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = expr,
  meta.data = meta,
  min.cells = 3,
  min.features = 100,
  project = "GSE180759_MS_brain"
)

obj
```

## Standardize metadata variables

```{r}
colnames(obj@meta.data)

#collapse MS samples into a single group
obj$group <- ifelse(
  grepl("control", obj$pathology, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "Control",
  "MS"
)

obj$group <- factor(obj$group, levels = c("Control", "MS")) #ensure stored as factor

#rename some columns
colnames(obj@meta.data) <- dplyr::recode(
  colnames(obj@meta.data),
  NBB_case = "donor",
  cell_type = "celltype"
)
```

## Explore distribution of MS and Control cells

```{r}
table(obj$group)
# Control      MS 
#    5291   61141 

table(obj$group, obj$donor)
  #         09_034 09_067 11_69 12_002 12_078 13_015 13_047 14_043
  # Control      0      0  1227   1795      0      0      0   2269
  # MS       12743   7533     0      0  12764   8356  19745      0
```

## Save Seurat object

```{r}
saveRDS(
  obj,
  file = here("scRNAseq_MS", "data", "processed", "Absinta_Seurat_obj.rds")
)

obj <- readRDS(
  file = here("scRNAseq_MS", "data", "processed", "Absinta_Seurat_obj.rds")
)
```

# QC and filtering

## QC parameters

```{r}
#calculate mitochondrial percentage per cell
obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^MT-")

VlnPlot(
  obj,
  features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
  ncol = 3 
)

#Low mitchondrial gene expression and other metrics look tight. Data was likely supplied pre-filtered for nFeature <2500 and percent.mt <5. 
```

## Filter/normalize data

```{r}
obj <- subset(obj, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)
obj <- NormalizeData(obj)
```

# Dimensionality reduction

## find variable features/scale

```{r}
obj <- FindVariableFeatures(
  obj,
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures = 3000
)

obj <- ScaleData(obj)
```

## PCA

```{r}
obj <- RunPCA(
  obj,
  npcs = 30
)

ElbowPlot(obj)
```

# Define clusters

## Cluster cells

```{r}
obj <- FindNeighbors(
  obj,
  dims = 1:15
)

obj <- FindClusters(
  obj,
  resolution = 0.4 #reasonable starting point for current purpose
)
```

## UMAP reduction

```{r}
obj <- RunUMAP(
  obj,
  dims = 1:20
)
```

## Visualize clusters

```{r}
DimP_All_Clus <- DimPlot(
  obj,
  reduction = "umap",
  label = TRUE,
  pt.size = 0.25
) 
DimP_All_Clus

#23 clusters were identified
```

```{r}
DimPlot(obj, group.by = "group")
DimPlot(obj, split.by = "group")

DimPlot(obj, group.by = "donor")
DimPlot(obj, split.by = "donor")

DimPlot(obj, group.by = "celltype")

#celltype clustering looks clean suggesting clustering worked well
```

## Define all other cell types (using prior identification)

```{r}
obj$cell_population_custom <- "Other cells"

obj$cell_population_custom[obj$celltype == "neurons"] <- "Neurons"
obj$cell_population_custom[obj$celltype == "opc"] <- "OPCs"
obj$cell_population_custom[obj$celltype == "oligodendrocytes"] <- "Oligodendrocytes"
obj$cell_population_custom[obj$celltype == "astrocytes"] <- "Astrocytes"
obj$cell_population_custom[obj$celltype == "vascular_cells"] <- "Endothelial/vascular cells"
obj$cell_population_custom[obj$celltype == "lymphocytes"] <- "Other immune cells"
obj$cell_population_custom[
  obj$celltype == "immune" & !(colnames(obj) %in% micro_cells)
] <- "Other immune cells"
obj$cell_population_custom[
  colnames(obj) %in% micro_cells
] <- "Microglia"

obj$cell_population_custom <- factor(
  obj$cell_population_custom,
  levels = c(
    "Neurons",
    "OPCs",
    "Oligodendrocytes",
    "Astrocytes",
    "Microglia",
    "Other immune cells",
    "Endothelial/vascular cells",
    "Other cells"
  )
)
```

## Plot results

```{r}
cell_cols <- c(
  "Neurons" = "#E69F00",
  "OPCs" = "#0072B2",
  "Oligodendrocytes" = "#56B4E9",
  "Astrocytes" = "#009E73",
  "Microglia" = "#7B1FA2",
  "Other immune cells" = "#D55E00",
  "Endothelial/vascular cells" = "#999999",
  "Other cells" = "gray80"
)

umap_df <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(obj, "umap"))
umap_df$group <- obj$group
umap_df$cell_population_custom <- obj$cell_population_custom
```

```{r}
plot_custom_umap <- function(group_name) {
  
  df <- subset(umap_df, group == group_name)
  
  ggplot(
    df,
    aes(
      x = umap_1,
      y = umap_2,
      color = cell_population_custom
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 0.22,
      alpha = 0.75
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = cell_cols,
      name = NULL,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(
          size = 4,
          alpha = 1
        )
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = group_name,
      x = "UMAP 1",
      y = "UMAP 2"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "Times"),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "lines"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.6, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.6, color = "black")
    )
}
```

```{r}
DimP_All_MS_celltype <- plot_custom_umap("Control")
DimP_All_Ctrl_celltype <- plot_custom_umap("MS")
DimP_All_celltype <- plot_custom_umap(c("MS", "Control"))

DimP_All_MS_celltype
DimP_All_Ctrl_celltype
DimP_All_celltype

# Selection of microglia is clearly much better! All cluster together. 
```

# Analyze glycolysis-high microglia

## Bin microglia based on glycolysis score

```{r}
# define as glycolysis high 65th percentile, glycolysis low 35th percentile (relaxed from 75th/25th due to low numbers of cells in some samples)
low_thresh  <- quantile(micro@meta.data$Glycolysis1, 0.35, na.rm = TRUE)
high_thresh <- quantile(micro@meta.data$Glycolysis1, 0.65, na.rm = TRUE)

# Add to object metadata
micro$gly_state <- case_when(
  is.na(micro$Glycolysis1) ~ NA_character_,
  micro$Glycolysis1 >= high_thresh ~ "High",
  micro$Glycolysis1 <= low_thresh  ~ "Low",
  TRUE ~ "Mid"
)
```

```{r}
table(micro$donor, micro$gly_state)
table(micro$seurat_clusters, micro$gly_state)
table(micro$group, micro$gly_state)
```

## Compile donor-level summary data

```{r}
donor_summary <- micro@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(group, donor, gly_state) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(donor)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(donor, group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_high  = sum(gly_state == "High", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_low   = sum(gly_state == "Low",  na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_high = 100 * n_high / n_total,
    pct_low  = 100 * n_low  / n_total,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Calculate donor-level statistics

```{r}
# donor counts
n_ctrl <- sum(donor_summary$group == "Control")
n_ms   <- sum(donor_summary$group == "MS")

# High comparison
p_high <- if (n_ctrl >= 2 & n_ms >= 2) {
  wilcox.test(pct_high ~ group, data = donor_summary)$p.value
} else {
  NA
}

mean_high <- donor_summary %>%
  dplyr::group_by(group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean = mean(pct_high), .groups = "drop")

diff_high <- 
  mean_high$mean[mean_high$group == "MS"] -
  mean_high$mean[mean_high$group == "Control"]

# Low comparison
p_low <- if (n_ctrl >= 2 & n_ms >= 2) {
  wilcox.test(pct_low ~ group, data = donor_summary)$p.value
} else {
  NA
}

mean_low <- donor_summary %>%
  dplyr::group_by(group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean = mean(pct_low), .groups = "drop")

diff_low <- 
  mean_low$mean[mean_low$group == "MS"] -
  mean_low$mean[mean_low$group == "Control"]

#Log fold
log2fc_high <- log2(
  (mean_high$mean[mean_high$group == "MS"] + 1e-6) /
  (mean_high$mean[mean_high$group == "Control"] + 1e-6)
)

log2fc_low <- log2(
  (mean_low$mean[mean_low$group == "MS"] + 1e-6) /
  (mean_low$mean[mean_low$group == "Control"] + 1e-6)
)
```

## Plot function

```{r}
plot_gly_pct <- function(df, y_var, p_val, diff_val, log2fc, title) {

  group_cols <- c("Control" = "blue", "MS" = "#B22222")

  y_max <- max(df[[y_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(df[[y_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min

label_txt <- paste0(
  "nCtrl=", sum(df$group == "Control"),
  "  nMS=", sum(df$group == "MS"),
  "\nΔmean=", round(diff_val, 2),
  "\nlog2FC=", round(log2fc, 2),
  if (!is.na(p_val)) paste0("\np=", signif(p_val, 2)) else ""
)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = group, y = .data[[y_var]], color = group)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.5,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      alpha = 0.15,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_quasirandom(
      width = 0.2,
      size = 2.5,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      fun = median,
      geom = "point",
      size = 3.5,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_cols) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 1.5,
      y = y_max + 0.12 * y_range,
      label = label_txt,
      family = "Times",
      size = 5
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = "% of cells per donor"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(y_min - 0.05 * y_range, y_max + 0.2 * y_range),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "Times"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.7),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.7),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 25, 10)
    )
}
```

##Create function for plotting %+ cells ##Updated function

```{r}
plot_positive_microglia <- function(gene) {
  
  # Fetch data
  
  df <- FetchData(
    micro,
    vars = c(gene, "group", "donor")
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(donor))
  
  df$group <- factor(df$group, levels = c("Control", "MS"))
  
  # Define positive cells
  ## threshold >0.25 to reduce noise/background
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(positive = ifelse(.data[[gene]] > 0.25, 1, 0))
  
  # Cell level counts (for visualization)
  
  pos_counts <- df %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(n_positive = sum(positive), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Group summary
  
  summary_df <- df %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(
      percent_positive = mean(positive) * 100,
      sem = sd(positive * 100) / sqrt(n()),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Donor-level summary (for stats)
  
  donor_df <- df %>%
    group_by(group, donor) %>%
    summarise(
      percent_positive = mean(positive) * 100,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Donor counts
  
  donor_counts <- donor_df %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(n_donors = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Set colors
  
  group_cols <- c(
    "Control" = "#4A90E2",
    "MS" = "#D0021B"
  )
  
  # axis limits
  
  y_max <- max(c(summary_df$percent_positive + summary_df$sem,
                 donor_df$percent_positive), na.rm = TRUE)
  y_lim <- y_max * 1.6
  
  # Donor-level statistics
  
  n_ctrl <- sum(donor_df$group == "Control")
  n_ms   <- sum(donor_df$group == "MS")
  
  p_value <- if (n_ctrl >= 2 & n_ms >= 2) {
    wilcox.test(percent_positive ~ group, data = donor_df)$p.value
  } else {
    NA
  }
  
  # Log2 fold change with pseudocount
  
  mean_df <- donor_df %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(mean_pct = mean(percent_positive), .groups = "drop")
  
  log2fc <- log2(
    (mean_df$mean_pct[mean_df$group == "MS"] + 1e-6) /
    (mean_df$mean_pct[mean_df$group == "Control"] + 1e-6)
  )
  
  # Label
  
  p_label <- paste0(
    "p = ", if (!is.na(p_value)) signif(p_value, 3) else "NA",
    "\nlog2FC = ", round(log2fc, 2)
  )
  
  # PLOT
  
  ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = group, y = percent_positive, fill = group)) +
    
    geom_col(width = 0.6, color = NA) +
    
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = percent_positive - sem, ymax = percent_positive + sem),
      width = 0.18,
      linewidth = 0.7,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    # plot donor points
    geom_jitter(
      data = donor_df,
      aes(x = group, y = percent_positive),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      width = 0.08,
      size = 2.5,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols) +
    
    # stats label (p + log2FC)
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 1.5,
      y = y_lim * 0.9,
      label = p_label,
      family = "Times New Roman",
      size = 4.5
    ) +
    
    # donor counts 
    geom_text(
      data = donor_counts,
      aes(
        x = group,
        y = -y_lim * 0.06,
        label = paste0("n=", n_donors)
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      family = "Times New Roman",
      size = 4
    ) +
    
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-y_lim * 0.1, y_lim), clip = "off") +
    
    labs(
      title = gene_titles[gene],
      x = NULL,
      y = paste0("% ", gsub("-positive Microglia", "-positive cells", gene_titles[gene]))
    ) +
        theme_classic() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.7, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.7, color = "black"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 25, 10)
    )
}
```

```{r}
)

log2fc_low <- log2(
  (mean_low$mean[mean_low$group == "MS"] + 1e-6) /
  (mean_low$mean[mean_low$group == "Control"] + 1e-6)
)
```

### Plot function

```{r}
plot_il6_pct <- function(df, y_var, p_val, diff_val, log2fc, title) {

  group_cols <- c("Control" = "blue", "MS" = "#B22222")

  y_max <- max(df[[y_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(df[[y_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min

label_txt <- paste0(
  "nCtrl=", sum(df$group == "Control"),
  "  nMS=", sum(df$group == "MS"),
  "\nΔmean=", round(diff_val, 2),
  "\nlog2FC=", round(log2fc, 2),
  if (!is.na(p_val)) paste0("\np=", signif(p_val, 2)) else ""
)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = group, y = .data[[y_var]], color = group)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.5,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      alpha = 0.15,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_quasirandom(
      width = 0.2,
      size = 2.5,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      fun = median,
      geom = "point",
      size = 3.5,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_cols) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 1.5,
      y = y_max + 0.12 * y_range,
      label = label_txt,
      family = "Times",
      size = 5
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = "% of cells per donor"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(y_min - 0.05 * y_range, y_max + 0.2 * y_range),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
        theme_classic() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "Times"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.7),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.7),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 25, 10)
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Cell-level data

# Donor-level summary
```

## Subset TNFA_NFKB high Mg and plot %

```{r}
# Define thresholds
low_thresh  <- quantile(micro@meta.data$TNFA_NFKB1, 0.35, na.rm = TRUE)
high_thresh <- quantile(micro@meta.data$TNFA_NFKB, 0.65, na.rm = TRUE)

# Add to object metadata
micro$tnf_state <- case_when(
  is.na(micro$TNFA_NFKB1) ~ NA_character_,
  micro$TNFA_NFKB1 >= high_thresh ~ "High",
  micro$TNFA_NFKB1 <= low_thresh  ~ "Low",
  TRUE ~ "Mid"
)
```

```{r}
donor_summary <- micro@meta.data %>%

  dplyr::filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(donor)) %>%
```

# Save figures

## Create function to save multiple figures

```{r}
save_figures <- function(
  plot_names,                 # character vector of plot object names
  figure_save_path,
  current_date,
  dataset_tag = NULL,         # e.g. "data2", "replicateB", "v2"
  sizes = NULL,               # optional named list: list(plot_name = c(w, h))
  default_size = c(6, 5),
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  ext = "jpg",
  env = parent.frame()        # environment where plot objects live
) {

  # ensure output directory exists
  dir.create(figure_save_path, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  # dataset suffix for filenames
  dataset_suffix <- if (!is.null(dataset_tag)) {
    paste0("_", dataset_tag)
  } else {
    ""
  }

  for (plot_name in plot_names) {

    # check plot exists
    if (!exists(plot_name, envir = env)) {
      warning(paste("Plot object not found:", plot_name))
      next
    }

    plot_obj <- get(plot_name, envir = env)

    # optional safety check
    if (!inherits(plot_obj, "ggplot")) {
      warning(paste("Object is not a ggplot:", plot_name))
      next
    }

    # determine size
    if (!is.null(sizes) && plot_name %in% names(sizes)) {
      width  <- sizes[[plot_name]][1]
      height <- sizes[[plot_name]][2]
    } else {
      width  <- default_size[1]
      height <- default_size[2]
    }

    # save plot
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(
        figure_save_path,
        paste0(current_date, "_", plot_name, dataset_suffix, ".", ext)
      ),
      plot = plot_obj,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      units = units,
      dpi = dpi
    )
  }
}
```
